art_direction: 奇犽银发与宽松得体上衣保持自然儿童形象，浅蓝色块和淡月轮配轻侧头倾听神态。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Create Killua Zoldyck with his recognizable silver-white hair and child face, wearing a loose but modest pale-blue top with a high dark undershirt collar. He tilts his head slightly as if listening, with an unforced small smile and both eyes clearly visible. Use graphic sky-blue, ivory, and slate blocks, keeping the hair as several distinct broad shapes. Preserve his young age and avoid adult fashion treatment. The head and shoulders fill the central area without cropping the hair tips. No props or dramatic scene are needed; the calm gaze and light hair silhouette should carry the avatar. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
